concept: Red slabs: the show's red becomes solid slabs that carry every title, wiping in on the cut like case-file tape; each freeze is a character file.
system: Bebas Neue (titles, names, numbers) + Inter 800/700 (subtitles, labels). Red #E0222B, ink #0B0B0C, white. Subtitles 62px, labels 30px, slabs 64-170px, names 228px. Margins 90px; titles in the top band 236-610px, subtitles bottom-anchored at 1420px, files 968-1423px. Wipes 0.42s expo-out in, 0.24s ease-in out; letters stagger 45ms.
